title: Why he came to Chicago: studying harmony at the Chicago Musical College
summary: Levy came to study violin and harmony and wanted to know what the jazz players were doing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: How'd you happen to come up to Chicago? Was there a job waiting for you?
No, I came up to go to the Chicago Musical College.

I was studying the violin and I was interested in the piano and also in the harmony. And then when I heard some of those guys doing all this stuff, you know, as far as my classical training, I wanted to find out
So I wanted to study harmony and find out, which I did. It was the most wonderful thing I ever did was study harmony in Chicago Musical College. and I really did. I had to pay.
